pr_title: ADR-0083 DENY + M01-P17 pipeline maturity + CLI canonicalization
summary: F9 product/plan review for PR #3: M01-P17 is directionally aligned with pipeline maturity, but the PR over-bundled unrelated adoption surfaces and left canonical hierarchy drift. Highest severity BLOCKER.

findings.issue: PR #3 added/advanced M01-P17 implementation-plan content, but the current machine-readable masterplan live index still shows M-CC with phase_count 10 and has no M01-P17/P11 entries. Agents reading the canonical masterplan JSON cannot discover the pipeline-maturity phase that PR #3 claims to advance.
findings.remediation: Regenerate `/specs/cross-cutting/masterplan.json#live_implementation_index` after P10/P11 additions and add a lane assertion that every `.omc/plans/milestones/*/phases/*/INDEX.md` phase appears in the machine-readable hierarchy.

findings.issue: The PR combined ADR-0083 strictness, M01-P17 planning, workflow changes, CLI/cargo refactors, docs, and migration artifacts. That violates the adoption ergonomics of the ChangeSet contract: reviewers and future implementers cannot isolate which product outcome each large slice proved.
findings.remediation: Backfill a PR #3 split ledger by IP/change boundary and require future large PRs to reference one owning IP or an explicit full-gate exception with impacted lock scopes.

findings.file: .omc/.project-memory.json.tmp.* and .audit/agent-read.jsonl in PR #3 tracked file list
findings.issue: Session memory/audit byproducts were committed with the product pipeline change. That hurts readability/adoption because local runtime residue is indistinguishable from canonical M01-P17 plan evidence.
findings.remediation: Remove tracked temp/session byproducts, add ignore/deny coverage for those patterns, and keep only smallest actionable evidence artifacts linked from the M01-P17 IP exit evidence.
